mechanism: Ginseng may potentiate antiplatelet effects and increase bleeding risk when combined with celecoxib's COX-2 inhibition-related antiplatelet activity; additionally, both substances may competitively inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 metabolism.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding (ecchymosis, hematuria, GI bleeding) and consider alternative herbal supplements; educate patient on increased hemorrhage risk.
